mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(release_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as releaseTime, count(*) as counts from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle where DATE_FORMAT(release_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = curdate() group by DATE_FORMAT(release_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') order by DATE_FORMAT(release_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i');

select count(*) as counts from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle where DATE_FORMAT(release_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = curdate() and DATE_FORMAT(release_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day) and is_delete = 0;
